card.name: The start of digoxin in drug lists
card.fires_on: The first piece "dig" of the drug name digoxin, when it appears in lists of interacting or co-administered drugs.

modes.label: Digoxin in a list
modes.description: "dig" begins digoxin inside a comma-separated list of other drugs.

modes.label: Digoxin in interaction table
modes.description: "Dig" starts digoxin as a row or entry in a drug-interaction table or sentence.
modes.example: Interactions with<< dig>>oxin, colchicine or phen

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted tokens are mixed and unrelated to digoxin.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening of the word digoxin when it is named among other drugs.
